reader_summary.headline: We are back in the world of aviation today, breaking down Embraer.
reader_summary.overview: We are back in the world of aviation today, breaking down Embraer. Embraer has carved out an interesting niche, manufacturing regional jets, business jets, and military aircrafts. Our guest is Richard Aboulafia, Managing Director at AeroDynamic Advisory and long-time aviation analyst and consultant.

key_points.text: We break down how this aviation success story grew out of Brazil, the evolution of the regional jet market, the business jet market.
Please enjoy this breakdown of Embraer.
